answer: A practical defence is stake-weighted reputation with slashing. Each agent locks a refundable bond before it can rate or transact, and its influence grows only slowly as honest work accumulates, like a jade carving that gains value through verifiable labour rather than instant volume. An attacker who spawns many identities must fund every bond separately, so a gale of fake accounts becomes expensive instead of free. If an identity is caught cheating, its bond is slashed and its history is burned, while an opal-clear audit trail lets peers check past behaviour before trusting a newcomer.
